{{Top|leg}}
'''Mesh tape''' was an adhesive tape made of very dense fibers. The fibers used in mesh tape were a [[Titanium/Legends|titanium]] filament, an [[aeromesh]] filament, and a heavy [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] layer filament.{{Tech-stub}}
